data.narrative:
Figure AI, a Series C AI & Software company founded by Brett Adcock, has raised over $1.0B to date. The peer universe for valuation consists of 1 public comparable (Palantir) and 8 private peers including Skild AI, Crusoe Energy, and Together AI at the same stage.

Stage-Progression analysis is not applicable here. The implied post-money valuation of $39B exceeds 20x the company's total capital raised, indicating the reported figure likely reflects a data-parsing error and lacks reliability for methodological use. Peer-Median triangulation, by contrast, is directly applicable. Using 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables—Skild AI ($14.0B), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B), and Together AI ($8.3B)—the median valuation is $10.0B, with a range of $8.3B to $14.0B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8.5B to $11.5B, centered on a median of $10.0B. This range reflects the peer median with modest adjustments for positioning within the comparable set. Key uncertainties include the reliability of private market pricing for early-stage AI companies, limited depth in the comp set (only 3 directly comparable transactions), and the absence of revenue or profitability metrics in the data provided. The current reported valuation of $39B appears inconsistent with both the peer set and capital-to-valuation ratios typical for the stage.
